what: Photos stacked in one slot switch to the next every 5 seconds. The active one slowly passes over 4.8s from 10% below to −10% above the slot height (cubic-bezier(0,.55,1,.45), slowing in the middle and speeding up at the end), turns on at the 25% point and starts turning off from 85% (linear). When there are several slot groups, each group runs .2s later, so big and small photos float up staggered. It runs only while the plate is on screen

options.every: Beat for advancing to the next slide (s), default 5
options.dur: Time for one slide to rise and pass by (s), default 4.8
options.shift: Travel distance (% of cell height), default 10 — 0 means it just turns on and off in place
options.[data-fx-part=stack]: Photo group (multiple allowed) — if absent, the element itself is one group

use: …

from.where: about.html .mm-amv__photos (large photo group and small photo group on the left of the navy panel) — original about.js mv-img: every 5000ms toggles is-active/is-prev, runs at ScrollTrigger top bottom and stops once it leaves · about.css img-transform 4800ms cubic-bezier(0,.55,1,.45) translate 10%→−10%, img-opacity 4800ms linear 0→1(25%)→1(85%)→0, --index × 200ms
